temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices that Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. In their dialogue, Gary appreciates Ethan's concern but declines the weekend retreat because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Before this event, Ethan likely saw Gary as a dedicated, hardworking friend but did not yet have a clear belief that Gary's work habits were dangerously harmful or that Gary needed intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan moves from general awareness of Gary's dedication to concern that Gary is overworking to the point of health risk and is unwilling or unable to step away because of hospital workload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is seriously overworked, neglecting his health, and resistant to taking a break due to hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and worried, with some frustration or helplessness at Gary's refusal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene by persuading Gary to rest and rejuvenate, and to keep encouraging him to take a break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussing work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary admits his situation is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked because of hospital demands and has been concerned that Gary is neglecting his health; he may assume the main cause is professional workload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restlessness, avoidance, and vague admission lead Ethan to suspect the overwork is not just professional but involves deeper personal problems Gary has been hiding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overworking has a more complicated, personal cause and that Gary has been carrying burdens alone to avoid burdening others.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, suspicious or curious, and increasingly empathetic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To get Gary to open up and to offer nonjudgmental help and support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he faces. Ethan hears these reasons and Gary agrees to Ethan's suggestions about prioritizing and delegating.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork is more than professional obligation and that Gary is hiding or struggling with personal issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan now understands the specific reasons behind Gary's behavior: new departmental management pressure plus personal challenges. This replaces suspicion with a clearer, more empathetic understanding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is explained by concrete work pressures and personal struggles, and that Gary can improve with help balancing tasks and responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary find a better balance by organizing his schedule, prioritizing tasks, and delegating responsibilities.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in with Gary and learns that Gary is making efforts to change and reports improvement. Gary says he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary understands the need for balance and is attempting to change with Ethan's support, but Ethan does not yet know how well Gary is sustaining that progress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reports of improvement and visible efforts strengthen Ethan's belief that Gary is successfully moving toward a healthier work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is making meaningful progress, is less overwhelmed, and is benefiting from support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support and encouragement, and remaining available to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees that Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and can manage on his own. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving and making progress, but he may still see himself as an active source of support or monitoring.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's sustained adjustment and self-reported control confirm that Gary no longer needs Ethan's active intervention and can maintain balance independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary has achieved a healthier work-life balance and is capable of managing on his own, while Ethan remains available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage independently, while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
